facts.fact: Bethany 发现自己已经醒来、完全清醒，正盯着床边一个真人大小（life-sized）的 static man。
facts.anchor: But here she was now, awake and staring at a life-sized static man at the edge of her bed.

facts.fact: Bethany 从床头柜上胡乱抓起自己的手机和 tote bag，跳下床。
facts.anchor: She grabbed her cellphone and her tote bag haphazardly off the nightstand and jumped out of bed.

facts.fact: Bethany 拧钥匙发动 Abel 的 Subaru，以每小时四十英里（forty miles an hour）疾驶离开那里。
facts.anchor: turning her key in the ignition of Abel’s Subaru, peeling out of there at forty miles an hour.

facts.fact: Bethany 车速至少超速三十英里（thirty over the speed limit），要尽快远离 Starlight Motel。
facts.anchor: She was going at least thirty over the speed limit, but she didn’t care. She needed to get far away from the Starlight Motel as quickly as possible.

facts.fact: Bethany 从后视镜里看到那个 man made of static 正坐在她的后座上，尖叫起来。
facts.anchor: Then she glanced in the rearview mirror and saw that the man made of static was sitting right in her backseat. Bethany screamed.

facts.fact: Bethany 车胎打滑、车辆失控，Abel 的 Subaru 冲上 overpass 的窄路肩，狠狠撞上一堵砖墙。
facts.anchor: Her tires skidded and she lost control of the vehicle. Abel’s Subaru careened across the overpass’s slim shoulder, slamming hard directly into a brick wall.

facts.fact: 一个卡车司机停下车，问 Bethany 后面那辆被撞毁的车（Abel 的 Subaru 残骸）是不是她的。
facts.anchor: “Is…is that your car back there?” he asked, eyeing the wreckage of Abel’s Subaru behind her.

facts.fact: Bethany 回答“No”，并自认严格来说这不算说谎，然后继续沿高速公路跛行前往 downtown。
facts.anchor: “No,” she said. And technically she wasn’t even lying. She continued limping on the highway, headed downtown.
